title: Ten years later: Gui Li
summary: In a rainy teahouse, Zhou Yixian tells the story of the great war: Zhang Xiaofan's secret came out, the Ghost King attacked Qingyun, and Bi Yao gave her life to shield him. Ten years later Zhang Xiaofan is Gui Li, Vice Master of the Ghost King Sect, and he wipes out the Blood-Refining Hall. Nian Laoda and Lin Feng surrender, but Ye Gou Daoren refuses to betray the hall, so Gui Li spares him and keeps him at his side. Back at the Ghost King Sect, Gui Li sits by Bi Yao's body and tells her about his mission, while Qing Long and Zhu Que warn that the Ghost King's training has not cured his longing for her. The Ghost King, who has taught him two volumes of the Heavenly Book, sends him to the Dead Swamp to strike the Longevity Hall and its master Yu Yangzi, in alliance with the Ten Thousand Poisons Sect and the He Huan Sect, while a treasure is said to be about to appear. On Qingyun, Lin Jingyu leaves the hidden elder who trained him for ten years, and sect leader Dao Xuan reveals he once secretly saved that elder. Dao Xuan sends the young disciples to the western swamp to keep the treasure from the Demon Sect, and Tian Yin Temple and Fen Xiang Valley send disciples too.
